title: Untitled (CD Torso Assemblage)
description: Large-scale vertical assemblage combines white paper panels, blue-and-white vertical stripes, and a row of compact discs strung across the upper register. Centered cardboard cutout depicts an inverted torso figure, flanked by red-and-blue ribbon stripes against multicolored side panels of blue, yellow, and green.
composition: vertical symmetry with central cardboard torso
